description: This file defines configuration settings for a service, including environment variable parsing, a Settings data class, and a function to load these settings. It is a core configuration module used for application setup.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A data class that encapsulates configuration options such as database URL, allowed origins, app name, version, and log level. Provides a static method to instantiate from environment variables.

methods.name: str|None _get_env(name: str, default: str | None = None)
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve environment variables with optional default.

methods.name: List[str] _parse_csv(value: str | None)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a list of strings, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: Settings.from_env
methods.description: Creates a Settings instance from environment variables, raising an error if required variables are missing.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Public function to obtain application settings from environment variables, intended to be used at app startup.

ctags.name: _get_env
ctags.pattern: /^def _get_env(name: str, default: str | None = None) -> str | None:$/
